references.text: The people believe in Jesus after he performs a sign (perhaps the first sign), which parallels the faith in John 7:31 following several signs.
The people follow Jesus and believe in him because they see the signs he performs on the sick, a direct parallel to the reasoning in John 7:31.
Many of the people believe in Jesus because of signs, leading them to leave others behind to meet him, reflecting the reaction in John 7:31.
Many of the Jews who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did believed in him, a direct parallel to faith based on signs in John 7:31.
